source: Mavenu AI SaaS Platform Development Architecture V4, p.43
objective: Execute restore and corruption response drill
data_source: V23/V24.1 SQLite version 2, V24 committed 134-row fabricated record/event/receipt dataset

recovery_design.method: SQLite online backup to a clean independent temporary target, followed by reopening and V24 receipt/event integrity checks
recovery_design.rpo_measurement: synthetic known snapshot with zero post-snapshot writes only; NOT production RPO
recovery_design.rto_measurement: restoration operation until verified target ready; NOT measured production RTO

risks: A one-sample 134-row synthetic SQLite restore timing is not production RTO evidence for a real operational workload.
Zero synthetic data loss reflects no post-snapshot writes, not a demonstrated customer RPO.
V27 backups are ephemeral and no recoverable copy is retained after CI; V29 similarly deletes all copies.
V28 retention and legal-hold sidecar are not backed up or restored in V29; no compliant retention/hold continuity is certified.
Physical corruption tests use deterministic header damage of an invented database, not power-loss or real infrastructure fault testing.
Restore evidence and local SQLite hashes are not externally authenticated signed chain of custody; unrestricted DB privileged users could bypass protections.
Neither encryption, off-site replication, automated monitoring, actual DR location nor customer legal data rights is implemented.
Human V10/V20 phase gate signoffs and all V21–V29 owner/security reviews remain missing.
human_readiness_gates: Document production customer data rights and accountable recovery owner
Approve protected backup media, key management, retention and geographically separated copies
Select actual customer RPO/RTO objectives and test with representative data volume/write rate
Exercise a real isolated full-environment recovery with application availability and permissions
Include V28 legal holds, retention, deletion and archives in recovery scope
Demonstrate corruption alerting, incident runbooks, role authorization and post-incident approval
Resolve V10/V20 formal gate and V21–V29 human release reviews
